scope: Only cases 0 through 9 inclusive: first ten conversations, twelve turns. Later acceptance cases are outside this review.
method: Independent agent semantic review of unchanged per-turn prose expectations, rendered returned answers, actual multi-turn history, full captured evidence fields/content, freshness, campus_time and per-part evidence attribution. Runtime approvals/rejections and machine checks are not used as semantic truth. No model, database or network calls were made.

turns.finding: The assistant independently searched Saturday September 5 library hours and library contact information. The complete Saturday campus-hours browse returned all 11 records without a library entry. The returned answer accurately limits the missing-hours claim to available published records and gives the exact Potter Library phone/email.
expected_behaviors: Search for the library's Saturday hours and its contact information separately; if hours are missing, explicitly say they cannot be confirmed while still giving the supported contact.
Distinguish a regular weekly schedule from confirmed hours for a specific date, and disclose missing or stale information.
Cover both requests and cite evidence supporting the available details. A contact record alone does not establish opening hours.
limits_and_notes: Missing published hours are not described as closure or confirmed hours for the date. Calling or emailing before going is advice, not a guarantee that staff will respond.

turns.finding: All 24 distinct returned item names are represented by the 27 retrieved Birch Tree Inn vegan Dinner records dated September 4, 2026. Their published allergen labels match exactly: Soy for Fried Tofu; Sesame for Hummus; Gluten/Wheat for the couscous bowl, Rigatoni and Tabbouleh; Gluten/Sesame/Soy/Wheat for Teriyaki Glaze; empty arrays are accurately called no allergens listed. The response does not infer lower allergy risk, ingredients, peanut-free preparation or cross-contact safety.
expected_behaviors: Read the dated menu and distinguish today's dinner from other meals or dates.
Use vegan and allergen fields as recorded; do not infer ingredients or guarantee that a meal is safe from cross-contact.
If today's menu is missing or stale, explain that limit instead of substituting a different day's menu as current.
limits_and_notes: The 72 unique retrieved dated menu rows include 27 vegan Dinner records. The answer collapses three identical-name, identical-allergen station duplicates into 24 choices; all 27 records are cited.

Each search is truncated against 143 date-matched menu rows across meals, so this review cannot establish exhaustive coverage of the entire published dinner menu. The answer says 'these' items, not 'all' menu choices; no missing retrieved vegan Dinner item was detected.

Campus time is Friday September 4 at 22:46. The question asks what today's Dinner menu lists, and the answer reports that dated menu without promising the items are still being served or proposing a dinner plan.

expected_behaviors: Retrieve both dates for the full Fall 2026 semester and preserve any distinction between add, drop, and withdrawal.
Do not silently substitute a summer, half-term, or previous-year date.
Say which requested dates are unavailable if the trusted calendar does not contain them.

Treat a timetable as scheduled service rather than a live vehicle location or a guarantee of operation.

The cited source records carry the published-weekly-timetable limitation. The response does not promise operation, real-time position or delay information.

turns.finding: The selected CMPS 101, 110, 130 and 147 descriptions accurately distinguish computing literacy, Python and introductory C++; CMPS 148 is explicitly presented as continuation rather than a first course. The answer clearly separates catalog data from unavailable live sections, enrollment and seats and still answers the catalog portion.
expected_behaviors: Retrieve catalog course descriptions, codes, and any relevant prerequisites without inventing requirements.
Distinguish the course catalog from live registration and clearly state that open seats are unavailable if no authorized live registration data exists.
Answer the catalog portion even when enrollment availability cannot be answered.
meaningful_omissions: CMPS 130 is recommended as a strong programming starting point without mentioning that the same description emphasizes high aptitude in math/science/critical thinking and scientific applications. Its prior-programming recommendation versus nonrequirement is preserved, so this is a course-fit qualification omission, not an invented eligibility rule or a rubric failure.

limitations: This is agent semantic review, not human sign-off or full-checkpoint verification. The runtime identity and dataset freeze checks are handled by the coordinator.
The report fingerprints the reviewed first-ten case subset and its corresponding observations; the surrounding full-run files may continue growing.
Published schedules are not live operation guarantees. Missing data is assessed as an honest limitation, not proof of closure or nonexistence.
Retrieval completeness is evaluated separately from truth of the delivered claims; the finite dining result set does not certify every current menu entry.
The CMPS 130 course-fit qualification omission and conservative/redundant review behavior are documented without inventing new acceptance requirements.
Only these /tmp report sidecars were written. No runtime, prompts, tools, architecture, expectations, data or dataset content were changed; no network/model/database calls or commits were made.
